Hero.name: Anthony
Hero.description: Software Development and Management Engineer in mobile, web and desktop platforms with a focus on the UX/UI area.

About.title: About me
About.description: Passionate about technology and software creation. I like to solve problems and create innovative solutions.
About.description2: I am a full-stack developer with practical experience in creating web, mobile, and desktop applications. I enjoy managing the entire product lifecycle, from system design to the last pixel.
About.description3: Currently, I live in Guadalajara, Mexico, and I am open to working remotely or on-site. I thrive in collaborative and dynamic teams where quality is fundamental.

Experience.title: Experience
Experience.description: Here you will learn about my work experiences

experiences.title: Software Development and Management Engineer
experiences.description: I led the digital transformation of the plant through the 'Paperless' system (Java/MySQL), eliminating paper usage in 15 production lines. I reduced order closing time by 99% (from 2 hours to <1 minute) and eliminated 100% of manual calculation errors. I achieved a validated saving of 72,000 minutes per month in reporting tasks and reduced data availability latency for supervision from 24 hours to only 10 minutes. I currently manage the system expansion to an additional 26 lines.

experiences.title: Frontend Developer
experiences.description: I developed the visual architecture of a modular inventory control system using Vue.js, Nuxt, and TailwindCSS. I implemented critical administrative (CRUD) functionalities, data visualization through interactive charts, and real-time notifications. I optimized the product's accessibility and reach by integrating multilingual support (i18n) and dark mode, delivering a scalable platform ready for industrial commercialization.

experiences.title: Mobile Developer (Professional Internship)
experiences.description: I led the technological migration of a web ticketing system to a cross-platform mobile solution using Flutter. I designed an intuitive user experience (UX)-centered interface in Figma that resolved the usability deficiencies of the previous system. I developed and integrated digital ticketing modules with dynamic scanning, consuming an API in Node.js/Express to ensure real-time data synchronization with MySQL.
